notes.title: Beta testing, round 2!
notes.notes:
Hi folks,

For those of you who missed out, we're adding a second batch of beta testers. Reply to John's tweet here for a free early key for the game: https://twitter.com/johnplewe/status/969649309678321664

Have a great weekend!
